Game Overview

In Haunted Graveyard, the core idea is straightforward: navigate a haunted graveyard where every step reveals lurking Halloween horrors. Leap onto zombies, skeletons, vampires, and eerie spiders to defeat them. Experience the thrill and suspense as you fight to survive and make it out alive. Can you brave the terrors of the night?
